camel_example: aliyun iot CreateSharePromotionSpeechModel --region cn-hangzhou --ShareTaskCode 52000000_700e_4003_900e_610000000000 --SharePromotionActivityId 61000000_0000_4901_0000_4700000000000 --SpeechModelType custom --Text test --AudioFormat wav --Voice Xiaoyun --BizCode ZFDZ
description_en: Creates a shared speech model for a promotional activity of a Qianli Chuanyin sharing task
description_zh: 调用该接口为千里传音分享任务的促销活动创建共享语料
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-share-promotion-speech-model --voice Xiaoyun --share-promotion-activity-id 61000000_0000_4901_0000_4700000000000 --speech-model-type custom --biz-code ZFDZ --audio-format wav --share-task-code 52000000_700e_4003_900e_610000000000 --text test --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSharePromotionSpeechModel

parameters.help_en: The voice for speech model playback, which is preset by the system, such as standard female voice or standard male voice. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html operation to query available voice types. Set this parameter to the Value in VoiceList from the response
parameters.help_zh: 语料播报声音，由系统预设，例如标准女声、标准男声等。可以选择的声音类型通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html进行查询，填入返回参数中**VoiceList**中**Value**的值
parameters.name: voice

parameters.help_en:
The promotional activity ID.

This is the Data value returned by the CreateSharePromotionActivity operation
parameters.help_zh:
促销活动ID。

调用接口CreateSharePromotionActivity返回的Data值
parameters.name: share_promotion_activity_id

parameters.help_en: The speech model type. Only the fixed value custom is supported, which indicates a custom speech model
parameters.help_zh: 语料类型，仅支持取值目前只支持固定值custom，表示自定义语料
parameters.name: speech_model_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The speech model identifier, which is user-defined. It supports letters and digits, with a length of 1 to 32 characters, and must be unique within the project.

Set the identifier to the initials of the speech model semantics in pinyin. For example, set `支付到账` (payment received) to `ZFDZ`
parameters.help_zh:
语料标识，由用户自定义，支持英文字母和数字，长度为1~32个字符，项目下保证唯一。

建议将语料语义的拼音首字母设置为语料标识，例如：`支付到账`设置为`ZFDZ`
parameters.name: biz_code

parameters.help_en: The playback speed. Valid values: -500 to 500
parameters.name: speech_rate

parameters.help_en: The audio format. Only wav and mp3 formats are supported
parameters.name: audio_format

parameters.help_en: The volume level. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en:
The share code of the sharing task.

For information about the share code, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607661.html
parameters.help_zh:
分享任务的分享码。

分享任务的分享码信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607661.html
parameters.name: share_task_code

parameters.help_en: The speech model text. It supports letters, Chinese characters, and spaces, with a length of 1 to 100 characters. A Chinese character occupies two characters
parameters.help_zh: 语料文本，支持英文字母、汉字和空格，长度为1~100个字符，一个汉字占两个字符
parameters.name: text

Code.description_zh:

调用成功，返回空值。
调用失败，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
